name: v1
description: A benchmark collection intended to evaluate automated agents or models in Android-related tasks (UI interactions, automation scripts, or app-centric tasks). It measures how well models can interpret instructions and produce sequences of actions or code to accomplish Android-specific goals. Tasks test practical command/action generation, robustness to diverse app states, and end-to-end task completion.
reputation: A small, domain-specific benchmark hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing use among mobile-automation and agent research groups.
